claims.hypothesis: Are the dark rings lower optical depth / column density features?
claims.experiment: Spectral index and T_B profiles across rings
claims.result: Dark rings have alpha ~2.3-3.0 and lower T_B than bright rings
claims.finding: Dark rings are optically thin with some grain growth

evidence.quote: demonstrates that the optical depth must be lower in the dark rings

claims.hypothesis: Do the rings point to planet formation?
claims.experiment: Ring ellipse fits and period ratios
claims.result: Center offsets increase with radius; near-integer resonances
claims.finding: Dark rings are likely gaps from planet formation

evidence.quote: suggest that the observed dark rings are low column density gaps in the disk material arising from the process of planet formation

claims.hypothesis: Can the molecular disk kinematics give the stellar mass?
claims.result: Roughly Keplerian pattern 2-12 km/s, absorption at low blue velocities
claims.finding: M*~1.3 Msun, needs radiative transfer refinement

evidence.quote: Future detailed radiative transfer analysis coupled with a physical model will be required

limitations_admitted.value: Subtle azimuthal features may reflect uv-coverage differences; 12CO misses flux from lack of short spacings

evidence.quote: we strongly caution against over-interpretation of subtle features unless verified by detailed modeling
